notes: A UK receipt: amounts carry a pound sign rather than a dollar sign, the date is day-first, and VAT is already inside the total rather than added to a subtotal. The subtotal ground truth is the one judgement call here — nothing labelled 'subtotal' is printed, so the defensible reading is the net of VAT (12.10 - 2.02), which is what the receipt means even though it does not say it.
